searchText: I believe it is possible to calculate an APR increase for a validator post merge (with and without MEV boost) from your data, right? It would be an interesting addition to your post IMO. PR for the boost relay to publish the block (via the beacon node API): https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost-relay/pull/103 - deployed on our Goerli relay To pick up on an earlier discussion, Nimbus will be increasing its timeout after submitting a signed, blinded block proposal to 4 seconds I am confused 😄 I used to think that the validator publishes the block. Does the relay publish the block? both just like in normal gossip -- once the valid block exists, anyone should publish to any available peer Does it matter who publishes it first? not really there is a concern about racy behavior if an entity controlled multiple proposers in a row and they were willing to get slashed if you scroll back up, the conversation in this channel since yesterday should shed some light on the question. bottom-line: it's only a win if the relay _also_ publishes the block, but the validator shouldn't rely on it and still publish it it may make a difference from a compliance perspective. In case you care... 😄 How does it matter for compliance whether the relay publishes the block?
